The '''Republic Domestic Security facility''' was the base of operations for the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Republic Domestic Security|Domestic Security]] (RDS) agency. [[Jilka Zan Zentis]] was taken there after she was arrested.
